---
title: "Gold Nanoclusters as a contrast agent for image-guided surgery of head and neck tumors"
date: 2019-09-18
description: "Study of ultrasmall gold nanoclusters as optical contrast agents for image-guided surgery of head and neck tumours."
categories: [Publication, Nanomedicine, Cancer Research, Molecular Imaging]

This work evaluated **ultrasmall gold nanoclusters** as optical contrast agents for image-guided surgery in head and neck tumours, at the interface of nanomedicine and translational imaging.
